title: DoSE approves stopgap teacher for GHSS Sungro

ai.summary: The Department of School Education approved a stopgap political science teacher for GHSS Sungro to address staff shortages that triggered agitation by the Lotha Middle Range Students’ Union.

facts.claim: Department of School Education (DoSE) has decided to post a postgraduate teacher (PGT) in political science at Government Higher Secondary School (GHSS), Sungro, as a stopgap arrangement to address the staff shortage that has triggered an agitation by the Lotha Middle Range Students’ Union (LMRSU).
facts.quote: Department of School Education (DoSE) has decided to post a postgraduate teacher (PGT) in political science at Government Higher Secondary School (GHSS), Sungro, as a stopgap arrangement to address the staff shortage that has triggered an agitation by the Lotha Middle Range Students’ Union (LMRSU).

ai.background_note: The Lotha Middle Range Students’ Union (LMRSU) has been protesting staff shortages at GHSS Sungro in Nagaland.
